Name: keccak.padder_.v1
Structural Path: keccak.in -> keccak.padder_.v1 -> keccak.padder_.out -> permutation state -> keccak.out
Attack Scenarios: Observing the input-buffer state after a legal input beat exposes the accepted message word before cryptographic diffusion.
Justification: This persistent input-buffer state captures the sensitive beat with full early information preservation and an output witness.

Name: keccak.padder_.out
Structural Path: keccak.in -> keccak.padder_.out -> f_permutation_.round_in -> permutation state -> keccak.out
Attack Scenarios: Observing the assembled padder block exposes multiple input words before the permutation transforms them.
Justification: The assembled padded block contains the sensitive input before permutation and is observable at valid output.

Name: keccak.padder_.p0.out
Structural Path: keccak.in -> keccak.padder_.p0.out -> padder selection -> f_permutation_.round_in -> keccak.out
Attack Scenarios: Observing the active padder lane under its legal selection phase reveals retained input information before absorption.
Justification: The active padder lane preserves input information early; the legal-don't-care audit still yields strong worst-case leakage evidence.

Name: keccak.f_permutation_.round_in
Structural Path: keccak.in -> padded block -> f_permutation_.round_in -> round_.out -> keccak.out
Attack Scenarios: Observing the absorption-round input exposes the padded message mixed into the still-structured permutation state.
Justification: This canonical permutation-round input carries the absorbed state and has a concrete path to keccak_out.

Name: keccak.f_permutation_.round_.out
Attack Scenarios: Observing a round output exposes an input-dependent intermediate state that propagates to a valid digest output.
Justification: The round output retains input-dependent state immediately upstream of the externally observable permutation chain.

Name: keccak.f_permutation_.out
Structural Path: keccak.in -> padded block -> round_.out -> f_permutation_.out -> keccak.out
Attack Scenarios: Reading the registered permutation state between rounds exposes a persistent input-dependent intermediate value.
Justification: This persistent permutation-state register carries input-dependent state across rounds and has measured temporal information and a valid-output observability witness.
